mechanism: Rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist with serotonergic activity, and nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may have indirect serotonergic effects; combined use increases risk of serotonin syndrome, particularly with concurrent serotonergic agents.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity); consider alternative analgesic if nalmefene required, or ensure careful patient counseling on warning signs.
